What we do

One crew for the whole floor.

Concrete coatings are the specialty — polishing and full-service flooring round it out, so a garage, a warehouse, and the rooms in between can all be handled in one call.

Concrete Coatings

Seamless epoxy and polyurethane systems that turn plain concrete into a surface that shrugs off tires, tools, spills, and foot traffic — and looks deliberate doing it.

Explore finishes →

Concrete Polishing

The concrete itself, ground, densified, and honed to a clean satin or gloss sheen. Nothing to peel, nothing to re-coat — just the slab, finished properly.

Plan a polished floor →

Flooring, Start to Finish

Beyond concrete: carpet, vinyl, wood, and laminate inside; artificial grass, outdoor surfaces, and stone & tile where the project calls for them.

Coating systems

Every coating job starts with the right system for the slab and the use it will see. These are the systems Valor installs — pricing is confirmed by phone for your specific floor.

  • 01
    Solid Color EpoxyA clean, uniform finish that brightens garages, shops, and workspaces.
  • 02
    Chip / Flake BroadcastDecorative flakes broadcast into the coating for texture, grip, and a granite-like depth.
  • 03
    Decorative MetallicPigments that flow and pool as they cure — a marbled, three-dimensional showpiece.
  • 04
    Seamless QuartzColored quartz aggregate in a seamless system — hard-wearing and easy to keep clean.
  • 05
    Industrial Floor CoatingHeavier-build systems for warehouses and facilities that take daily punishment.
  • 06
    PolyurethaneA tough, UV-stable topcoat option where sunlight and abrasion are part of the job.
  • 07
    Concrete StainingColor worked into the slab itself for a natural, variegated, stone-like character.
  • 08
    Concrete PolishingMechanical refinement of the slab — from matte honed to a high-gloss shine.

How it works

From bare slab to finished floor.

STEP 01

Talk it through

Call any day between 7 AM and 7 PM. Describe the space and the finish you're picturing — pricing for your floor is confirmed on that call.

STEP 02

Prep the concrete

The slab is cleaned, repaired, and mechanically profiled so the coating bonds to the concrete instead of just sitting on it.

STEP 03

Apply the system

Base coat, broadcast or metallic work, and topcoat go down in sequence — each layer timed to the one before it.

STEP 04

Cure & walk it

Once cured, the floor goes back to work: seamless, easy to clean, and ready for tires, traffic, or a showroom spotlight.

Ready when the floor is.
